records.rule: Use the explicitly named local scope; refuse implicit whole-tree fallback.

records.trigger: Job activation/execution has returned confirmation token
records.rule: Do not represent a bearer token as independent operator identity evidence.

records.trigger: Child rc=0 but ERROR: or space breach observed
records.rule: Preserve child_rc=0 and emit independent exception observation and status.

records.trigger: Repository has a project-specific deploy-key alias
records.rule: Preserve the Git remote and ssh_config identity selection; inspect before effects.
Report native suite inconsistency and require deterministic full qualification.
